headlines.text: Flash back to 2021, when Adam Cole competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Frankie Kazarian, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.88.

Back on this day in 2023, Kris Statlander vs. Jade Cargill fought tooth and nail for the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.16 ? a good, competitive contest. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Back on this day in 2021, Dante & Sydal made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.55.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2021, when it was the first-ever encounter between Darby Allin and Shawn Spears on Dynamite, rated 6.22.
Turning the clock back to 2021: Jade Cargill vs. Leyla Hirsch locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 4.77.
Rewind to 2021, when Kingston & Moxley vs. 2.O locked horns for the first time, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 4.70.
